title: Epsilon-greedy action probabilities
statement_md:
Write `epsilon_greedy_probs(q_values, epsilon)` returning the probability of each
action under epsilon-greedy.

- with probability `1 - epsilon` play a greedy action; split that mass evenly
  among tied best actions
- with probability `epsilon` pick uniformly at random over all `k` actions
- the returned list must have one probability per action and sum to 1

Raise `ValueError` for an empty `q_values` or an `epsilon` outside `[0, 1]`.
Return floats. For `epsilon = 0.2` and four arms, the greedy arm gets `0.85`.
